summary: Iteration 2 — Re-test of two bug fixes in Umang Hometech LLP CRM (frontend-only, after E1 fix). VERIFIED BOTH FIXES PASS via UI + API. (1) action-site-visit in LeadDetailModal NOW creates a SiteVisit record (POST /api/visits with tomorrow 11:00 default) AND the new visit shows up on /visits page in 'SCHEDULED' status, with all 5 expected action buttons (Visit Completed / Reschedule / Interested / Not Interested / Booking Ready). Confirmed by selecting TEST_RETEST_E2E lead in /telecaller, clicking Mark Positive, then action-site-visit; /visits page then displays the visit card immediately. (2) /visits Schedule-Visit modal date field on web is now a real HTML <input type='datetime-local'> (verified attribute type='datetime-local' on data-testid=visit-date-input), with proper try/catch error feedback wiring. Smoke pass on /whatsapp, /employees, /negative-leads, /dashboard — all expected testIDs present. Pipeline kanban renders correctly with NEW LEAD and SITE VISIT columns populated. Booking/Loan modals & advance flow already verified end-to-end at backend level in iteration_1 (11/11 pytest). One residual issue from iteration_1 unchanged: TopBar still missing testID='user-menu' on the avatar.

critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetailModal.scheduleVisit() correctly POSTs /api/visits with tomorrow 11AM default (Date object setHours(11,0,0,0) → ISO). Good.

visits.tsx CreateVisitModal correctly branches on Platform.OS==='web' to render <input type='datetime-local'> with data-testid (lowercase data-testid is required for HTML element to be picked up by playwright; React Native testID would not apply to a raw HTML <input>). Correct implementation.
Error UX in CreateVisitModal: try/catch around new Date(date) parse + try/catch around api.post returning detail. Good defensive coverage.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: action-site-visit in LeadDetailModal only patched lead.stage='site_visit' but did not call POST /api/visits, so /visits page stayed empty after the action. Fix applied by E1: added scheduleVisit() in LeadDetailModal that POSTs /api/visits with lead_id and scheduled_at = tomorrow 11AM ISO. Verified — visit card appears on /visits immediately after the action. Secondary fix: /visits Schedule-Visit modal now uses HTML <input type='datetime-local'> on web (Platform.OS==='web' branch) with data-testid='visit-date-input', and try/catch error display for invalid date / backend failure. Both fixes confirmed.
